title: Elite: Noon Made Hostile
description: Elite remix of Noon Made Hostile: the same story pressure becomes a sharper tactical problem, not a stat-inflated repeat.
lore: This mission shows the Sun Realm refusing panic: law, river, and formation answer the Gate wound without rewriting established Canon.
terrain: sun throne ascent with boss gate, split lanes, and multi-phase eclipse zones

objectives.primary: Clear the field while maintaining formation near river-light cover. Elite remix: complete it while stabilizing a secondary solar seal.
optional: Stop every reinforcement trigger or defeat the reinforcement commander first

enemyWaves.entry: split flanks with one enemy already contesting an objective

boss.mechanic: changes start positions, suppresses one recovery lane, and forces objective timing

specialRules: Eclipse Phase: the boss changes terrain rules at health or objective thresholds.
Watching Gate: delay increases defeat pressure and locks some recovery tiles.
Elite Remix: enemy AI prioritizes objectives and exposed support Titans.
Restricted Recovery: healing or recovery tiles deactivate after use.
victoryConditions: Clear the field while maintaining formation near river-light cover.
Secondary solar seal stabilized before extraction

firstClear: Elite Aten Ra mission 18 codex shard

stars.three: Primary, secondary, and all optional objectives completed
